findings.description: Decisions D1-D3 in design.md define normative inventory in docs/guides/state-artifacts.md, establish question-scoped authority for the five durable artifact classes (loop-state.json, checkpoint.json, learning entries, session-log.md phase records, handoffs/mirrors), and separate fresh session bootstrap locators from canonical file verification.
findings.resolution: Question-scoped authority and bootstrap locator semantics are cleanly isolated across all five durable state classes.

findings.description: The OpenSpec delta under specs/skill-workflow/spec.md specifies unambiguous requirements and scenarios for five-class state discovery, conflict resolution favoring canonical records over advisory handoffs or queue projections, fail-loud missing-state degradation, portable skill links, and byte-identical runtime mirrors.
findings.resolution: Specification requirements provide complete traceability for all durable state artifact behaviors and verification boundaries.

findings.description: The single sequential work package wp-state-artifacts-docs in work-packages.yaml correctly bounds file locks and write allowlists across docs/guides/state-artifacts.md, six canonical SKILL.md sources, test files under skills/tests/state-artifacts/, .agents and .claude mirrors, and the generated decision index docs/decisions/skill-workflow.md.
findings.resolution: Work package scoping and locks strictly prevent context drift while allowing regenerated decision index outputs.

findings.description: The structural RED/GREEN test suite in skills/tests/state-artifacts/test_state_artifacts_guide.py validates five-class inventory headers, 8-step rehydration order markers in docs/guides/state-artifacts.md and skills/supervise/SKILL.md, portable link URLs across all six skill files, and byte identity for .agents and .claude runtime mirrors.
findings.resolution: Structural pytest contract ensures robust validation without fragile prose pinning.

findings.description: The plan iteration findings in plan-findings.md explicitly document the disposition of Round 1 vendor reviews, justify the single sequential package DAG, and reconcile PhaseRecord.write_both() regenerating docs/decisions/skill-workflow.md upon recording decision D1.
findings.resolution: Plan findings reconcile derived artifact generation and lock allowlists while preserving single-package DAG rationale.

findings.description: The supervised rehydration section in skills/supervise/SKILL.md aligns with the 8-step rehydration sequence defined in docs/guides/state-artifacts.md, separating the supervisor handoff/mirror bootstrap locator from canonical roadmap checkpoint and change loop-state verification.
findings.resolution: Supervise skill prose accurately reflects the canonical rehydration sequence without altering underlying runtime interfaces.
